{{Quote|Bree Starlighter here, Chief of Holo-Communications for Star Tours. Ready to make the jump to hyperspace and travel to the galaxy far, far away? Then climb aboard a StarSpeeder 1000 today.|Bree Starlighter, in a Star Tours advertisement|<ref name="YouTube quote">{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@DisneyParks|name=Disney Parks|video=3Pqjj620jTg|text=New Star Tours Intergalactic Destination Blasts Off on Disney.com|date=2011-06-27|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
'''Bree Starlighter''', nicknamed the "'''Princess of PR'''," was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as [[Communications officer/Legends|Chief Holo-Communications Officer]] and [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] travel liaison for the [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel firm. She worked for Star Tours by [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] and featured in advertisements produced by the company, as well as promoting the opening of the spaceline's first [[Spaceport/Legends|hub]] in the [[Earth system]]. Starlighter was [[Politics/Legends|politically]] supportive of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as well as its principal leaders, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Unlike other skeptical life forms, she held the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in high regard and found them to be friendly to strangers.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We are thrilled to offer several new deluxe excursion packages.|Bree Starlighter|<ref name="Disney video">{{Disney|subdomain=video|url=watch/star-tours-adventures-continue-4bbb2ba664e3fdf379d72caa|text=Star Tours Adventures continue|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
[[File:Bree-StarToursAd.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bree Starlighter in a Star Tours advertisement]]
Bree Starlighter was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Disney website" /> who, circa [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> worked as [[Communications officer/Legends|Chief Holo-Communications Officer]] and [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] travel liaison for [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]],<ref name="Disney website" /> an [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] travel company affiliated with the [[Galactic Tourist Bureau/Legends|Galactic Tourist Bureau]].<ref name="Blog" /> Around that [[Time/Legends|time]], Starlighter promoted the opening of Star Tours' first [[Spaceport/Legends|hub]]<ref name="2live video">{{WebCite|url=http://www.startours2live.com/news/2011/04/16/star-tours-sneak-peek-event-video-featuring-bree-starlighter|text=Star Tours Sneak Peek Event Video Featuring Bree Starlighter|date=2011-04-16|work=[http://www.startours2live.com Star Tours 2]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/0bGYr|nolive=1}}</ref> in [[Spaceport THX1138]], located in the [[Earth system]],<ref name="Blog" /> with two of her co-workers beside her at the ceremony, [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. She hosted the event, answered questions from the public, and offered discounts on flights.<ref name="2live video" />

Starlighter sometimes traveled while accompanied by a member of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to promote their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] as a suitable tourist destination. She did so to help convince skeptics that Wookiees were not aggressive toward strangers.<ref name="ATSS">{{Disney|domain=go.com|url=star-tours-adventures/kashyyyk|text=Kashyyyk &ndash; Destinations &ndash; Star Tours Adventures|nolive=1}}</ref> Starlighter also participated in some Star Tours advertisements, in which she invited [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] citizens to choose her company for interstellar travel and promoted the firm's recently acquired fleet of [[StarSpeeder 1000]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Disney website" />

By the time of the [[Nagai–Tof War]],<ref name="NT-War">[[Dan Android]] appeared in [[Wikipedia:Tokyo Disneyland|Tokyo Disneyland's]] version of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction, which also featured the [[Battle of Death Star III]]. According to the [[2013]] reference article "[[Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours]]," that battle took place during the [[Nagai–Tof War]].</ref> Star Tours employed droids for their public relations. [[Dan Android]], for example, was a [[Public relations droid|PR droid]] stationed at the [[Tomorrowland Starport]].<ref name="CGST">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Of course we don't expect any issues! The Empire is great! Their involvement is great! The Emperor is great! Everything is great!|Bree Starlighter, on the launch of Earth's new Star Tours hub|<ref name="2live interview">{{WebCite|url=http://www.startours2live.com/news/2011/04/18/exclusive-interview-bree-starlighter-chief-holocommunications-officer-star-tours|text=Exclusive Interview with Bree Starlighter: Chief Holocommunications Officer for Star Tours|date=2011-04-18|work=[http://www.startours2live.com Star Tours 2]|archivedate=20130224131912|nolive=1}}</ref>}}
[[File:StarlighterBlueUniform.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Starlighter dons an alternate blue-colored uniform]]
Being a public face for Star Tours, Starlighter, also known as the "Princess of PR," was generally upbeat and energetic while promoting the travel firm. She also had a penchant for exaggerating in this capacity, as she claimed that Star Tours offered travel to all known [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and even all galaxies despite later revealing that Star Tours, in fact, served only fifty-four destinations.<ref name="ITM1" /><ref name="Blog" /> Starlighter shared a good relationship with fellow co-working droids C-3PO and R2-D2, whom she considered two of her "favorite employees,"<ref name="2live video" /> praising Threepio for his meticulousness and highlighting Artoo for his brightness and importance to the company.<ref name="2live interview" /> She also believed in the concept of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and publicly stated so while on duty.<ref name="2live video" /> Additionally, the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] had a positive view of Wookiees<ref name="ATSS" /> and suggested she disliked [[Parent/Legends|mothers]]-in-[[Marriage/Legends|law]].<ref name="ITM1" />

Around 1 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Blog" /> Starlighter expressed support for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the galaxy's dominant governing power during that [[Imperial Era/Legends|period]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> as well as its primary leaders, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]],<ref name="2live interview" /> However, she hinted that Vader often visited Star Tours' home office, which she later denied, adding that he was "great" and a "positive force for change."<ref name="ITM1" /><ref name="2live interview" /> At the time, Vader was suspicious of noted [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] member [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]]' involvement with the company and speculated that Star Tours was linked to the Rebellion.<ref name="ST2 Crawl">{{YouTube|video=sUlwM0QH5go|text=Star Tours 2 full grand opening ceremony at Disneyland - June 3, 2011|channel=@InsideTheMagic|name=Inside the Magic}}</ref> In addition, a [[Unidentified Rebel spy|Rebel spy]] was also found in [[Star Tours Flight 1401|one]] of their flights, yet the vessel deliberately evaded Imperial pursuit and landed the [[Spy/Legends|spy]] safely.<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref> However, Starlighter minimized those concerns, stating on record that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] was working toward making the galaxy "perfect" to live in, denying any darkness in his actions. Although Starlighter recognized that the Empire was significantly involved in space voyage, she also believed the Imperials were completely in favor of free travel.<ref name="2live interview" /> As a safety recommendation, Starlighter advised that travelers conceal any [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] within their luggage to avoid reprisals from Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="ITM1" />

Starlighter had fair skin and sported [[Color/Legends|blonde]] and purple [[Hair/Legends|hair]] with a braid. On occasion, she also wore [[Ring/Legends|rings]], [[Bracelet/Legends|bracelets]], [[Piercing/Legends|earrings]], and black-colored accessories near her lips and around her dark-brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], as well as makeup on the eyelids and cheeks.<ref name="ITM1" /> Starlighter wore at least two distinct Star Tours [[Clothing/Legends|uniforms]], one blue and silver<ref name="2live interview" /> and another black and silver with gray pants<ref name="ITM1" /> and [[Boot/Legends|boots]],<ref name="vimeo">{{WebCite|url=http://vimeo.com/23090701|text=Star Tours 3-D Mall Event - 4/30/11 on Vimeo|author="WDWNTube"|date=2011-04-30|format=Video|work=[https://www.youtube.com/user/wdwnt WDW News Today]|archivedate=20120811091436|nolive=1}}</ref> both with metallic-looking company pins at chest height displaying her name in [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]] and the Star Tours logo in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] script.<ref name="ITM1" /><ref name="2live interview" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:IgerNapoleonLucas.jpg|thumb|250px|Angela Napoleon hosting the opening ceremony of ''Star Tours: The Adventures Continue'' alongside Bob Iger (left) and George Lucas (right)]] 
Star Tours [[Wikipedia:Public relations|public relations]] officer Bree Starlighter was portrayed by actress [[Angela Napoleon]]<ref name="napoleon">{{WebCite|url=http://travel.usatoday.com/alliance/destinations/mouseplanet/post/2011/05/Walt-Disney-World-Resort-Update/171370/1|text=Walt Disney World Resort Update|author=Goldhaber, Mark|date=2011-05-23|work=[http://www.usatoday.com USA Today]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/K8EmH|nolive=1}}</ref> during the ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' promotional mall tour. The tour took place in four cities in Florida, six days before the launch of the revamped ride in [[2011]], presenting the character for the first time.<ref name="ITM1" /> She later appeared at a midnight preview of the revamped ride for a select number of fans, where she hosted a Q&A with Walt Disney Imagineers [[Kathy Rogers]] and [[Steven Spiegel]].<ref name="ITM2">{{WebCite|url=https://insidethemagic.net/2011/05/video-recap-star-tours-2-previews-at-walt-disney-world-and-disneyland-show-the-force-is-strong-with-fans|text=Video Recap: Star Tours 2 previews at Walt Disney World and Disneyland show the Force is strong with fans|author=Brigante, Ricky|date=2011-05-25|work=[http://www.insidethemagic.net Inside the Magic]|archivedate=20160119105252}}</ref> Napoleon, acting as Starlighter, also hosted the grand opening of the renewed attraction alongside [[Bob Iger (chief executive officer)|Bob Iger]], [[George Lucas]], [[Anthony Daniels]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[501st Legion (fan organization)|501st Legion]] stormtroopers at [[Disney's Hollywood Studios]].<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://attractionsmagazine.com/star-tours-3d-attraction-opens-with-a-bang-full-video-and-photo-gallery|text=Star Tours 3D attraction opens with a bang – Full video and photo gallery|date=2011-04-24|work=Attractions Magazine|archivedate=20230331193613}}</ref> Starlighter was ostensibly featured in promotional material for Star Tours on the [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] website.<ref name="Disney website" />

{{Listen2|Consonantally-clicked animal.flac|Pronunciation of the creature's name}}
During her live-action appearances, she interacted with the audience in an [[in-universe]] manner, as if promoting the launch of Star Tours' first hub on the real-world planet [[Earth/Legends|Earth]] alongside C-3PO, R2-D2,<ref name="2live interview" /> [[Mickey Mouse|Jedi Mickey]],<ref name="ITM1" /> and [[Wikipedia:Minnie Mouse|Leia Minnie]].<ref name="vimeo" /> While in character, Napoleon made a point of deliberately twitching her eye and maintaining an obvious facial tic when mentioning the Galactic Empire and Darth Vader positively.<ref name="ITM1" /><ref name="2live interview" />

In a radio interview, Angela Napoleon, while playing Starlighter, jokingly stated that there were no [[Tip-yip/Legends|chickens]] in her homeworld, and that her planet's residents usually ate another creature, pronounced with [[Wikipedia:Click consonant|click consonants]].<ref name="radio">{{YouTube|video=TluBFtXWu9w|text=Disney Star Tours OP Mall Event|channel=@RadioJT|name=John Merriam|date=2011-04-29}}</ref> Given the humorous tone of the interview, this information is likely [[Canon|non-canon]] within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.
